# secureaccess_resource_connector (Resource)

This resource manages a Resource Connector, which is previously registered with Cisco Secure Access outside of Terraform.
 Implicit import of the resource will be performed based on the `instance_id` attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_resource_connector" "example" {
  instance_id       = "i-0123456789abdef1"
  enabled           = true
  confirmed         = true
  delete_on_destroy = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) The instance ID of the Resource Connector.

### Optional

- `confirmed` (Boolean) Indicates whether the Connector exists. Once confirmed, it cannot be changed.
- `delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) When `true`, the Resource Connector is removed from Secure Access on destroy. When `false`, it is only removed from the Terraform state.
  - Default value: `false`
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the Connector can receive traffic.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the Resource Connector.
- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `resource_connector_group_id` (Number) The ID of the Resource Connector Group to which this connector belongs.
- `status` (String) The status of the Resource Connector.
- `version` (String) The version of the Resource Connector.
